findPage.description: 用户分页：姓名模糊（like 自动转义）+ 部门 + 状态，三个条件都可选。逻辑删除条件由框架自动追加
sql: SELECT id, user_name, email, dept, status, role, created_at
AND (#1 IS NULL OR user_name LIKE #1)   -- [1] like keyword 姓名模糊，自动转义，不用自己拼 %
AND (#2 IS NULL OR dept = #2)           -- [2] string dept    部门
AND (#3 IS NULL OR status = #3)         -- [3] string status  状态 ACTIVE/INACTIVE

findByUserName.description: 登录用：按用户名取一条，含密码哈希。框架会自动追加 deleted = 0
sql: SELECT id, user_name, email, dept, status, role, password_hash, created_at
WHERE user_name = #1        -- [1] string userName 用户名

countByDept.description: 按部门统计人数（只算未删除的）

pagination.countSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT dept FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY dept) t

recycleList.description: 回收站：已逻辑删除的用户（显式写 deleted = 1，框架不会再加 deleted = 0）
sql: SELECT id, user_name, email, dept, status, updated_at, updated_by
